dossier.anchor_quote: Fire a noxious arrow at the ground, creating a cloud of flammable poisonous gas at the end of its flight. The cloud will detonate if hit by a Detonator skill or if an Ignited enemy touches it.

payload_json.loop_verbatim: Fire Gas Arrow at ground to create poison gas cloud (4-second duration, expands over time, limit 6 clouds). Any fire damage or ignited enemy contact detonates cloud in large fire explosion (100% phys-to-fire conversion on detonation). Standard 0.1-0.2 loop: cast Gas Arrow then Flame Wall to ignite and detonate.

geometry_bands.source_anchor: Two-stage: arrow projectile places a poison gas cloud at ground target (1.8m -> +80% radius over 4s; limit 6 clouds); any fire/ignited-enemy contact DETONATES the cloud in a large fire explosion (100% phys-to-fire on detonation). Dominant every-3s loop is the DETONATION -- the large-zone fire blast at cloud position -> ground_targeted_circle. The cloud-placement projectile is the arming stage (noted). fire primary (detonation) + earth secondary (poison gas). burn (ignite) + poison ailments.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: TWO-STAGE cloud->detonate (addendum C.4 / main-law 7.2 dominant loop): DOMINANT geometry = the DETONATION (large-zone fire blast, probe footprint=large-zone, geo_raw large-AOE) -> ground_targeted_circle; the Gas-Arrow cloud-placement projectile is the ALTERNATIVE/arming stage, NOTED (mid-range projectile). Hybrid element: fire primary (100% phys-to-fire on detonation IS the damage) + earth secondary (poison gas -- venom-themed, main-law poison row); ailments burn (ignite->burn) + poison. The place->ignite->detonate is an apply-consume pair (cloud is the mark; ignition consumes it -> burst) but proc_trigger on-ailment-application (ignite triggers detonation). ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL door: 100% phys-to-fire conversion on detonation is a build-defining conversion. Guide archived after 0.3 ignite changes (dossier) -- mapped the attested 0.1-0.3 place+Flame-Wall-detonate identity. verify_ledger: identity+mechanics+era CONFIRMED 0.1-0.3-edict.
